figures.caption: Figure 1: An overview of the proposed CSAG-GNN framework. The model decouples graph learning into a Feature View (Step 1) and a Structure View (Step 2) optimized via a cyclic alternating scheme. The feature encoder distills a structure-agnostic prior Fϕ, which acts as an alignment anchor (Lalign) for the intermediate embeddings of the task-driven CSAG-GNN. The embedded CSAG-Layer dynamically balances dual-branch aggregations using an adaptive gating mechanism.
Table 1: Comparison experiment results for graph dataset: Node Classification Accuracy (%). The best and second-best results are in bold and underlined, respectively.
